section: New York corporate income and franchise taxes
label: Corporation franchise tax rate on business income over $5 million

source_title: NY Department of Taxation and Finance: Tax facts, Corporate taxes

section: New York corporate income and franchise taxes
label: MTA additional tax (Metropolitan Commuter Transportation District)
note: The MTA surcharge is 30% of the state franchise tax apportioned to the 12-county MCTD (NYC, Nassau, Suffolk, Westchester, Rockland, Orange, Putnam, Dutchess); about 2.18% at the top rate.
source_title: NY Department of Taxation and Finance: Tax facts, Corporate taxes

section: New York corporate income and franchise taxes
label: Business capital tax rate
note: Alternative base; tax on capital limited to $5 million. Zero for qualified manufacturers, emerging technology companies and small businesses. Published for 2025 tax years.
source_title: NY Department of Taxation and Finance: Article 9-A definitions and rates (updated October 21, 2025; tax years beginning in 2025)

section: New York corporate income and franchise taxes
label: Fixed dollar minimum tax
value: $25 (NY receipts up to $100,000) to $200,000 (NY receipts over $1 billion)
note: Corporations pay the highest of the business income, capital and fixed dollar minimum bases. Published for 2025 tax years.
source_title: NY Department of Taxation and Finance: Article 9-A definitions and rates (updated October 21, 2025; tax years beginning in 2025)

section: New York property tax: state rules
label: Levied by
value: Counties, cities, towns, villages, school districts and special districts
note: The State does not collect or receive property tax; school districts levy the largest share.
source_title: NY Department of Taxation and Finance: Learn about property taxes (updated July 26, 2024)

section: New York property tax: state rules
label: State oversight
value: NY Department of Taxation and Finance, Office of Real Property Tax Services (ORPTS)
note: Supports more than 1,000 local governments that levy property tax.
source_title: NY Department of Taxation and Finance: Tax facts, Property tax

section: New York property tax: state rules
label: Property tax levy cap
value: Annual levy growth limited to 2% or the rate of inflation, whichever is less
note: Applies to local governments and school districts outside the Big Five cities; can be overridden by a 60% vote. Guidance published 2011 (cap later made permanent).
source_title: NY Department of Taxation and Finance and Department of State: Publication 1000, The Property Tax Cap, Guidelines for Implementation (10/11)

section: New York real estate transfer tax
label: State real estate transfer tax
value: $2 per $500 of consideration (or fraction), when consideration exceeds $500
note: Equivalent to 0.4%. Paid by the seller; if the seller does not pay or is exempt, the buyer must pay.
source_title: NY Department of Taxation and Finance: Real estate transfer tax (updated June 1, 2026)

section: New York real estate transfer tax
label: Mansion tax (residences of $1 million or more)
note: Additional 1% of the sale price on residences sold for $1 million or more; paid by the buyer.
source_title: NY Department of Taxation and Finance: Real estate transfer tax (updated June 1, 2026)

section: New York real estate transfer tax
label: New York City additional state taxes
value: Additional base tax $1.25 per $500 (residential $3M+, other property $2M+); supplemental tax 0.25% to 2.9% on residential $2M+
note: State taxes on NYC conveyances since July 1, 2019; supplemental tax rates are in Form TP-584-NYC-I. Separate from the City's own transfer tax.
source_title: NY Department of Taxation and Finance: Real estate transfer tax (updated June 1, 2026)

section: New York real estate transfer tax
label: Who pays
value: Seller pays the base and additional base tax; buyer pays the mansion tax and supplemental tax
note: If the responsible party does not pay or is exempt, the other party must pay.
source_title: NY Department of Taxation and Finance: Real estate transfer tax (updated June 1, 2026)
